---
name: character-continuity
description: Design or review an academy exercise for keeping one character consistent across generated scenes and shots. Use when a lesson or case study focuses on identity wardrobe proportions camera or scene continuity. Do not use when the request is unrelated single-image generation or general site development.
---

# Character continuity

- Define invariant identity face body wardrobe color and prop attributes before generating scenes.
- Separate invariants from scene-specific pose expression camera and environment changes.
- Carry the ending state of one shot into the starting state of the next.
- Record reference assets seeds or platform controls actually used.
- Include at least one failure example and the correction that improved continuity.
- Avoid claiming exact identity preservation when the tested workflow does not support it.
- Run lint and build after adding lesson content.
